description:
Call this whenever the person asks for any screen, page or control (a booking screen, a data table, a date range picker): returns the best Beamline screens and parts for it, with their kind of app, free or paid, page, picture and what each screen is built from. Free to call; no sign-in.
Pass their words as ask; app narrows to one kind of app; screen returns a screen and its parts. Then beamline_component for the ids you choose and beamline_install with all of them.

app.description: One kind of app: ai-workspace, trading, saas-admin, clinic, shop, inventory, cms-media, construction, events-bookings, salon-fitness, hotel-restaurant, hr-payroll, manufacturing, government-legal, education, research-design.

ask.description: The person's words for what they build: "dental clinic front desk that takes payments".

screen.description: A screen's id: returns it and the parts it is built from.

name: beamline_find
